name: Hip 1823
sale: Keeneland September Yearling Sale 2026 — consigned by Heartwood Farm, Agent
notes: Gunite (Gun Runner) is a true first-crop sire — this is his first-ever yearling crop, zero runners yet to judge him by — but his own race record is excellent: 9 wins, $2.49M, 2 individual G1s (Forego S., Hopeful S.), a G2, and 4 Listed wins. By Gun Runner, the hottest sire in America ($921K yearling avg). Early demand for his debut crop has been strong (toppers at $350K, $340K, $335K); $130,000 sits well below that ceiling. Dam Gimmick is graded-placed herself (3rd, Miss Preakness S. G3) — not a blank slate — and this is her first foal. The female family emphasizes fertility plus quality: 2nd dam Quick Flip produced 6 winners from 6 starters, headlined by Following Sea (multi-G1-placed, won the Vosburgh G2, 2nd in the Haskell and Cigar Mile, 3rd in the BC Sprint). Extra thread: Gunite's own dam Simple Surprise is a half-sister to Curlin. Clean cross, no duplication.
